mapper.select: SELECT INSTANCE_ID, TENANT_ID, CHAT_ID, OUTCOME, WEBHOOK_URL, STATUS, ATTEMPTS, NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT, LAST_ERROR, CLAIMED_BY, CLAIMED_UNTIL, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM WF_TERMINAL_EVENT_OUTBOX WHERE DELETED=0 AND (1=0)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WF_TERMINAL_EVENT_OUTBOX (INSTANCE_ID, TENANT_ID, CHAT_ID, OUTCOME, WEBHOOK_URL, STATUS, ATTEMPTS, NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT, LAST_ERROR, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{instanceId}, #{tenantId}, #{chatId}, #{outcome}, #{webhookUrl}, 'PENDING', 0, #{nextAttemptAt}, NULL, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE TENANT_ID=CASE WHEN DELETED=0 THEN VALUES(TENANT_ID) ELSE TENANT_ID END, CHAT_ID=CASE WHEN DELETED=0 THEN VALUES(CHAT_ID) ELSE CHAT_ID END, OUTCOME=CASE WHEN DELETED=0 THEN VALUES(OUTCOME) ELSE OUTCOME END, WEBHOOK_URL=CASE WHEN DELETED=0 THEN VALUES(WEBHOOK_URL) ELSE WEBHOOK_URL END, STATUS=CASE WHEN DELETED=0 THEN 'PENDING' ELSE STATUS END, ATTEMPTS=CASE WHEN DELETED=0 THEN 0 ELSE ATTEMPTS END, NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT=CASE WHEN DELETED=0 THEN VALUES(NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT) ELSE NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT END, LAST_ERROR=CASE WHEN DELETED=0 THEN NULL ELSE LAST_ERROR END, CLAIMED_BY=CASE WHEN DELETED=0 THEN NULL ELSE CLAIMED_BY END, CLAIMED_UNTIL=CASE WHEN DELETED=0 THEN NULL ELSE CLAIMED_UNTIL END, UPDATED_AT=CASE WHEN DELETED=0 THEN VALUES(UPDATED_AT) ELSE UPDATED_AT END
mapper.update: UPDATE WF_TERMINAL_EVENT_OUTBOX SET STATUS='DELIVERED', CLAIMED_BY=NULL, CLAIMED_UNTIL=NULL, UPDATED_AT=#{updatedAt} WHERE DELETED=0 AND (INSTANCE_ID=#{instanceId} AND STATUS='IN_PROGRESS' AND CLAIMED_BY=#{claimedBy} AND CLAIMED_UNTIL > #{claimedUntil})

UPDATE WF_TERMINAL_EVENT_OUTBOX SET STATUS='PENDING', ATTEMPTS=#{attempts}, NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT=#{nextAttemptAt}, LAST_ERROR=#{lastError}, CLAIMED_BY=NULL, CLAIMED_UNTIL=NULL, UPDATED_AT=#{updatedAt} WHERE DELETED=0 AND (INSTANCE_ID=#{instanceId} AND STATUS='IN_PROGRESS' AND CLAIMED_BY=#{claimedBy} AND CLAIMED_UNTIL > #{claimedUntil})

UPDATE WF_TERMINAL_EVENT_OUTBOX SET STATUS='DEAD', ATTEMPTS=#{attempts}, LAST_ERROR=#{lastError}, CLAIMED_BY=NULL, CLAIMED_UNTIL=NULL, UPDATED_AT=#{updatedAt} WHERE DELETED=0 AND (INSTANCE_ID=#{instanceId} AND STATUS='IN_PROGRESS' AND CLAIMED_BY=#{claimedBy} AND CLAIMED_UNTIL > #{claimedUntil})
UPDATE WF_TERMINAL_EVENT_OUTBOX SET DELETED=1 WHERE DELETED=0 AND (INSTANCE_ID=#{instanceId})
mapper.select: SELECT INSTANCE_ID,TENANT_ID,CHAT_ID,OUTCOME,WEBHOOK_URL,ATTEMPTS,CLAIMED_BY FROM WF_TERMINAL_EVENT_OUTBOX WHERE DELETED=0 AND (STATUS='IN_PROGRESS' AND CLAIMED_BY=#{owner} AND INSTANCE_ID IN #{id}) ORDER BY NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT ASC LIMIT #{limit}
